title: Finite-Z_q GKP Coset Comb State Poisson Summation Dual Comb and Shift Error Correction
claims: For q = d * M, the primal coset comb state |C_{d, s_0}> = M^{-1/2} sum_{k=0}^{M-1} |s_0 + k*d mod q> transforms under QFT_q into the exact reciprocal comb d^{-1/2} sum_{r=0}^{d-1} exp(2*pi*i s_0 r / d) |r * M> with zero out-of-comb leakage.
Measuring the QFT register modulo M uniquely diagnoses and corrects any modular frequency shift error |e_f| <= (M - 1) // 2, restoring 100% deterministic recovery of s_0 in Z_d.
